name: Tokyo Futarigurashi. ~Kyousoukyoku~
original_name: 東京二人暮らし。　〜協奏曲〜
source:
Main character loses memory from a trifle. He lives with another person and has to pretend that they are lovers. But this false life can't last for long. Several incidents happen to protagonist. Can he play along?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
